speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. How long have you been experiencing these symptoms of fatigue, abdominal pain, night sweats, and weight loss? Also, can you tell me if the enlarged lymph node near your collarbone is painful or if it has grown recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of tuberculosis or recent travel to an area where it is common? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: CT_Scan_Abdomen_Pelvis. REQUEST TEST: Biopsy_Supraclavicular_Lymph_Node. REQUEST IMAGES. Given the fixed, painless node and systemic symptoms, I need to rule out malignancy immediately.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT Scan Thorax and Abdomen: Massively enlarged axillary, mediastinal, and cervical lymph nodes. Biopsy of Cervical Lymph Node: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20. Blood Work: Elevated WBC, slightly decreased Hemoglobin, elevated Lactate Dehydrogenase. Physical Exam: Nontender, enlarged, fixed supraclavicular lymph node; Splenomegaly; Dullness over left lower quadrant.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy results showing CD20-positive lymphocytes with a high proliferative index, combined with your B-symptoms and widespread lymphadenopathy, confirm a diagnosis of B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma.
